item.title: Base Rate Rises But Treasury Bond Yields Fall... Easing Concerns Over July and August Rate Hikes (기준금리 올랐는데 국고채 금리 하락…7·8월 인상 우려 덜어)
item.description:
On the 16th, despite the Bank of Korea raising the base rate (to an annual 2.75%) for the first time in three years and six months, treasury bond market yields fell across the board as some concerns over an additional base rate hike in August eased. (16일 한국은행이 3년6개월 만에 기준금리를 인상(연 2.75%)했음에도 이날 국고채 시장금리는 오는 8월 추가 기준금리 인상에 대한 우려가 일부 완화하면서 일제히 하락했다.)

On the Seoul bond market that day, the yield on three-year treasury bonds closed at 3.848% per annum, down 1.8bp (1bp=0.01 percentage point) from the previous day. The yield on 10-year bonds also fell by 3.0bp to an annual 4.297%. (이날 서울 채권시장에서 3년 만기 국고채 금리는 전날보다 1.8bp(1bp=0.01%포인트) 내린 연 3.848%에 장을 마쳤다. 10년물 금리도 연 4.297%로 3.0bp 하락했다.)

Bond market experts assessed that bond prices strengthened (a drop in bond yields means a rise in bond prices) as concerns over consecutive base rate hikes in July and August eased. A bond trader at a securities firm said, "Bonds showed strength as the wariness about a hawkish (monetary tightening preference) Monetary Policy Committee dissipated," adding, "It appears that the bond selling trend that had emerged due to expectations that the Bank of Korea could raise rates again in August following this month's hike has been reversed." (채권시장 전문가들은 7, 8월 연속 기준금리 인상에 대한 우려를 덜면서 채권가격이 오히려 강세(채권금리 하락은 채권값 상승을 의미)를 나타냈다고 평가했다. 증권사의 한 채권 운용역은 “매파적(통화긴축 선호)인 금통위에 대한 경계감을 해소하면서 채권이 강세를 나타냈다”며 “이달 기준금리 인상에 이어 한은이 8월에도 금리 인상에 나설 수 있다는 전망으로 그동안 나타났던 채권 매도세가 다시 되돌려진 모습”이라고 말했다.)

He added, "However, there was no active bond buying ahead of the holiday. The possibility of a rate hike in August cannot yet be completely ruled out, so the direction of market rates may be limited until we confirm growth or inflation indicators." (그는 “다만, 휴일을 앞두고 적극적인 채권 매수세는 아니었다. 아직은 8월 금리 인상 가능성을 완전히 배제할 순 없어 성장률이나 물가 지표를 확인 전까지는 시장금리 방향이 제한될 수 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Senior Reporter Cho Kye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Between ICE and EVs’ PHEVs… Domestic gap filled by Japanese, then Chinese makers (‘내연기관-전기차 사이’ PHEV…국산 빈 자리, 일본 이어 중국까지 치고든다)
item.description:
“I really want to switch to an electric car, but I visit my parents in the countryside two or three times a month, and it’s over 400 km round trip. I think I’d be stressed about charging every time.” In a recent post on an online car community, Mr. A explained why he is looking into plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs). He noted that he can drive on electricity for daily commutes and use the engine for long distances, reducing the burden of charging. (“전기차로 바꾸고 싶은 마음은 크지만, 한 달에 두세 번씩 시골 부모님 댁에 다녀오는데 왕복 400㎞가 넘거든요. 갈 때마다 충전 때문에 스트레스일 것 같더라고요.” 최근 한 자동차 온라인 커뮤니티에 올라온 글에서 ㄱ씨는 플러그인하이브리드차(PHEV)를 알아보고 있는 이유에 대해 이렇게 적었다. 평소 출퇴근 때는 전기 주행을 하고, 장거리에서는 엔진을 써 충전 부담을 줄일 수 있다고 본 것이다.)

As Mr. A’s dilemma shows, plug-in hybrid electric vehicles offer a choice that combines the advantages of both electric cars and conventional hybrids. However, from another perspective, they can also appear as a “neither here nor there” option. Consumers with access to charging infrastructure are likely to choose EVs, while those seeking to avoid the hassle of charging tend to opt for conventional hybrids. Additionally, the structure that combines an engine, electric motor, a larger battery than a hybrid, and external charging equipment increases the price burden. This is why PHEVs have not established a foothold in the domestic market. According to statistics from the Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association, among imported cars newly registered this year in the 30 million won range, there are 436 hybrids, but not a single plug-in hybrid in the same price bracket. (ㄱ씨의 고민에서 알 수 있듯 플러그인하이브리드차는 전기차와 일반 하이브리드차의 장점을 함께 기대할 수 있는 선택지다. 그러나 반대로 보면 ‘이도 저도 아닌’ 선택지로 비칠 여지도 크다. 충전 환경을 갖춘 소비자는 전기차를, 충전 부담을 피하려는 소비자는 일반 하이브리드차를 택하기 쉽기 때문이다. 여기에 엔진과 전기모터, 하이브리드차보다 큰 배터리와 외부 충전 장치를 함께 갖춘 구조는 가격 부담을 키운다. 국내 시장에서 플러그인하이브리드차가 자리 잡지 못한 배경이다. 한국수입자동차협회 통계를 보면, 올해 새로 등록된 3천만원대 수입차 중 하이브리드차는 436대지만, 같은 가격대의 플러그인하이브리드차는 한 대도 없다.)

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy’s “Eco-Friendly Vehicle Registration List” shows a similar trend. Among this year’s newly registered vehicles, there are 78 EV models by detailed specifications, 12 hybrids, and only 2 PHEVs. While models like Hyundai’s Sonata and Ioniq, Kia’s K5 and Niro, and GM Korea’s Chevrolet Volt were once available domestically, no domestic PHEV models are currently sold. An official from a domestic automaker that previously sold PHEVs said, “Considering the domestic market’s electrification environment and customer preferences, we focused on other electrified product lines.” The abolition of the 5 million won per-vehicle government subsidy in 2021 also weakened policy incentives. (산업통상부 ‘환경친화적 자동차 등재 목록’을 봐도 비슷하다. 올해 신규 등재 차량 가운데 전기차는 세부 모델 기준 78건, 하이브리드차는 12건인데 플러그인하이브리드차는 2건에 그쳤다. 한때 현대차 쏘나타·아이오닉, 기아 케이(K)5·니로, 한국지엠 쉐보레 볼트(Volt) 등 플러그인하이브리드차 모델이 국내에 출시됐지만, 지금은 판매 중인 국산차가 없다. 과거 플러그인하이브리드차를 판매했던 한 국내 완성차 업체 관계자는 “국내 시장의 전동화 환경과 고객 선호 등을 고려해 다른 전동화 상품군에 집중한 결과”라고 말했다. 대당 500만원의 국고보조금도 2021년 폐지되면서 정책적 유인이 약한 점도 한몫했다.)

Recently, however, imported carmakers are again seizing this gap, judging that market conditions have changed due to lower fuel costs, expanded charging infrastructure, and falling battery prices. Professor Kim Pil-su of Daelim University (Department of Future Automotive Engineering) said of PHEVs, “As technology advances and battery prices drop, competitiveness has increased. For consumers hesitant to switch directly to EVs, it can serve as a middle ground.” (그런데 최근 수입차 업체들이 이 빈틈을 다시 파고들고 있다. 연료비 부담과 충전 시설 확충, 배터리 가격 하락 등으로 시장 조건이 달라졌다는 판단에서다. 김필수 대림대 교수(미래자동차공학부)는 플러그인하이브리드차를 두고 “기술이 발전하고 배터리 가격이 하락하면서 경쟁력이 높아졌다”며 “전기차로 바로 넘어가기 부담스러운 소비자에게 중간 선택지가 될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Toyota placed two PHEV trims in the all-new RAV4 launched last month, offering a premium option that adds charging capability and electric driving performance, albeit pricier than conventional hybrids. Demand remains steady. Korea Toyota Motor announced that the proportion of PHEVs in contracts has risen from 30% at launch to 40% recently. BYD is taking a lower-price approach. BYD Korea started presales last month for the mid-sized SUV Sealion 6 DM-i front-wheel drive model at 37.5 million won, which is lower than representative domestic mid-sized hybrid SUVs starting around 40 million won. (토요타는 지난달 출시한 올 뉴 라브4에 PHEV 2개 트림을 배치해 일반 하이브리드차보다 비싸지만, 충전 기능과 전기 주행 성능을 더한 상위 선택지를 제시했다. 수요도 꾸준하다. 한국토요타자동차는 계약 기준 플러그인하이브리드 비중이 출시 당시 30% 수준에서 최근 40%로 높아졌다고 밝혔다. 비야디(BYD)는 가격대를 낮춰 접근한다. 비와이디코리아가 지난달 사전계약을 시작한 중형 스포츠유틸리티차(SUV) 씨라이언 6 디엠아이(DM-i) 전륜구동 모델 가격은 3750만원으로, 4천만원 안팎에서 시작하는 대표 국산 중형 하이브리드 에스유브이보다 낮은 수준이다.)

Still, some view the growth of the PHEV market itself with caution. Lee Ho-jung, head of the Industry Research Office at the Korea Automotive Research Institute, said, “If Chinese brand PHEVs increase, rather than creating a separate market, they are likely to erode part of the domestic hybrid car market.” (다만, 플러그인하이브리드차 시장 자체가 커질지는 지켜봐야 한다는 시각도 있다. 이호중 한국자동차연구원 산업조사실장은 “중국 브랜드 플러그인하이브리드차가 늘면 별도 시장이 커지기보다 국산 하이브리드차 시장의 일부를 잠식하는 구도가 형성될 가능성이 있다”고 말했다.)

Yoo Ha-young Reporter yhy@hani.co.kr (유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Homeplus secures 200 billion won, keeps revival hope alive but path to normalization remains rocky (‘2천억 확보’ 홈플러스, 회생 불씨 살렸지만 정상화는 ‘험로’)
item.description:
Homeplus, which was on the brink of bankruptcy, has secured 200 billion won in emergency operating funds (DIP) from its largest creditor, Meritz Financial Group. The funding was finalized after major shareholder MBK Partners and MBK Partners Chairman Kim Byung-ju agreed to provide joint and several guarantees for the full loan amount. With the emergency funds in place, Homeplus plans to file an immediate appeal on the 20th in response to the Seoul Bankruptcy Court's decision to terminate its rehabilitation procedures. (파산 위기에 몰렸던 홈플러스가 최대 채권자인 메리츠금융그룹으로부터 2천억원 규모의 긴급운영자금(DIP)을 지원받게 됐다. 대주주인 엠비케이(MBK)파트너스와 김병주 엠비케이파트너스 회장이 대출금 전액에 대해 연대보증을 서기로 하면서 지원이 성사됐다. 긴급운영자금을 마련한 홈플러스는 서울회생법원의 회생절차 폐지 결정에 대응해 오는 20일 즉시항고 할 예정이다.)

Meritz Securities, Meritz Capital, and Meritz Fire & Marine Insurance, creditors of Homeplus, held a board meeting on the 16th and approved an agenda to provide 200 billion won in emergency operating loans to Homeplus. Meritz Financial Group issued a statement that day, saying, "We have decided to provide the full 200 billion won in emergency operating funds to share the difficulties faced by Homeplus employees and small business owners and fulfill our social responsibility as a financial institution." (홈플러스 채권자인 메리츠증권·메리츠캐피탈·메리츠화재는 16일 이사회를 열어 홈플러스 쪽에 2천억원 규모의 긴급운영자금을 대출한다는 내용의 안건을 의결했다. 메리츠금융그룹은 이날 입장문을 내어 “홈플러스 임직원과 소상공인이 겪고 있는 어려움을 나누고 금융의 사회적 책임을 다하기 위해 긴급운영자금 2천억원 전액을 지원하기로 결정했다”고 밝혔다.)

Meritz and MBK had been at odds over the funding plan. Meritz had maintained that it could provide 100 billion won on the condition of guarantees from MBK and Chairman Kim Byung-ju, with MBK responsible for the remaining 100 billion won, while MBK had resisted additional support. (그동안 이 자금 조달 방안을 놓고 메리츠와 엠비케이는 대치를 이어왔다. 메리츠는 “엠비케이와 김병주 회장의 보증을 전제로 1천억원을 투입할 수 있으며, 나머지 1천억원은 엠비케이가 부담해야 한다”는 입장이었고 엠비케이는 추가 지원은 어렵다고 맞서왔다.)

The stalled negotiations came to a dramatic conclusion, largely attributed to political pressure. The Democratic Party's Euljiro Committee pressured both sides to secure funds and scheduled a hearing for the 27th, which spurred progress in the talks. The union's participation in mutual cooperation also played a role in the dramatic resolution. (지지부진하던 협상이 극적으로 타결된 데는 정치권의 압박이 주효했던 것으로 풀이된다. 더불어민주당 을지로위원회가 양쪽에 자금 마련을 압박하고 오는 27일로 청문회를 예고하면서 협상이 진전됐다. 노조의 상생 동참도 극적 타결에 역할을 했다.)

However, even with the emergency funds secured, there are numerous challenges to address before Homeplus store operations stabilize. Even after the funding inflow is confirmed, time is needed for judicial procedures and infrastructure restoration. If Homeplus files an immediate appeal with the court on the 20th, the court will review whether to cancel the previous decision to terminate rehabilitation procedures and decide whether to resume them. Operational challenges also remain. The company must resolve the planned electricity and water disconnection issues starting on the 20th, and it needs to negotiate supply conditions and advance payment plans with suppliers to ensure smooth product delivery. Min Byung-deok, chairman of the Democratic Party's Euljiro Committee, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day, emphasizing, "Homeplus has not yet revived. With the opportunity to prevent bankruptcy and push for rehabilitation anew, the major shareholder must present and implement a responsible plan for management normalization." The Mart Industry Union also issued a statement that day, saying, "The road to Homeplus' normalization is still long," and urged, "Follow-up measures such as management normalization, job stability, and protection of partner and tenant businesses must be promptly established. We call for the government's continued role in normalizing Homeplus." (다만, 긴급운영자금이 마련됐지만 실제 홈플러스 매장 운영이 안정 궤도에 오르기까지 해결해야 할 과제는 적지 않다. 자금 유입이 결정되더라도 사법적 절차 이행과 인프라 복구 등에 시간이 필요하기 때문이다. 20일 홈플러스가 법원에 즉시항고를 제기하면, 재판부는 기존의 회생절차 폐지 결정 취소 여부를 심리한 뒤 회생절차를 재개할지 결정하게 된다. 운영상의 과제도 남아 있다. 20일부터 예고된 단전·단수 문제도 해결해야 하는데다, 원활한 물품 공급을 위해 납품업체들과 공급 조건과 선급금 지급 방안도 조율해야 한다. 민병덕 민주당 을지로위원회 위원장도 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “(아직) 홈플러스가 살아난 것은 아니다. 파산을 막고 회생을 재추진할 기회를 얻은 만큼, 대주주가 책임 있는 경영 정상화 계획을 내놓고 이행해야 한다”고 강조했다. 마트산업노조도 이날 성명을 내어 “홈플러스 정상화의 길은 여전히 멀다”며 “경영 정상화와 고용 안정, 협력업체 및 입점업체 보호 등 후속 대책이 조속히 마련돼야 한다. 홈플러스 정상화를 위한 정부의 지속적인 역할을 촉구한다”고 했다.)

Homeplus stated, "Once the court approves the extension of rehabilitation procedures and permits the emergency operating loan, and subsequent procedures such as consent from major creditors to the rehabilitation plan are completed, the funds will be disbursed." The secured funds will be used primarily for unpaid wages, payment for goods, and various tax payments. Homeplus plans to decide on the schedule for resuming operations at its large marts, which entered temporary closure starting on the 13th, after consulting with partner companies following the court's decision to extend the rehabilitation procedures. (홈플러스 쪽은 “법원의 회생절차 연장 결정과 긴급운영자금 차입 허가가 이뤄지고, 주요 채권자들의 회생계획 동의 등 후속 절차가 마무리되면 자금이 집행될 것”이라고 밝혔다. 확보한 자금은 체불임금과 상품대금 지급을 비롯해 각종 세금 납부 등에 우선하여 사용할 계획이다. 홈플러스는 법원의 회생절차 연장 결정 이후 협력업체들과의 협의를 거쳐, 지난 13일부터 임시휴업에 들어간 대형마트 영업 재개 일정을 결정한다는 방침이다.)

item.title: Kookmin University's HUSS Global Symbiosis Project Group Operates Global Field Education Program in Australia (국민대 HUSS 글로벌공생사업단, 호주 글로벌 현장교육 프로그램 운영)
item.description:
Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol) HUSS Global Symbiosis Project Group operated the '2026 Australia Global Resource Coordinator Programme' in Sydney, Australia, for eight days from Wednesday, June 17 to Wednesday, June 24. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) HUSS 글로벌공생사업단은 2026년 6월 17일(수)부터 24일(수)까지 8일간 호주 시드니에서 ‘2026 호주 글로벌리소스코디네이터 프로그램(Global Resource Coordinator Programme)’을 운영했다.)

This program is an overseas field-type extracurricular course linked to the joint curriculum 'Global Korean Studies and Korean Language Education' of the HUSS Global Symbiosis Project Group. Held for the second time following 2025, it involved 28 students from Kwangwoon University, Kookmin University, Sun Moon University, Yeungnam University, and Honam University, along with four supervising professors. Lee Dong-eun, Deputy Director of the HUSS Global Symbiosis Project Group at Kookmin University, oversaw the entire schedule. (이번 프로그램은 HUSS 글로벌공생사업단의 공동 교과목인 ‘글로벌한국학과한국어교육’과 연계한 해외 현장형 비교과 과정이다. 2025년에 이어 두 번째로 열렸으며, 광운대·국민대·선문대·영남대·호남대 학생 28명과 인솔 교수 4명이 참여했다. 이동은 국민대 HUSS 글로벌공생사업단 부단장이 전체 일정을 총괄했다.)

Key activities included a collaborative problem-based learning (PBL) project with students from the University of New South Wales (UNSW). Six UNSW students, who rank 19th globally in the 2027 QS World University Rankings, and 28 consortium students formed six mixed teams to carry out a 'Global Project for the Restoration of Biological, Linguistic, and Cultural Diversity.' (주요 과정으로는 호주 뉴사우스웨일스대학교(UNSW) 학생들과의 공동 문제 기반 학습(PBL) 프로젝트가 진행됐다. 2027 QS 세계대학평가에서 세계 19위를 기록한 UNSW의 학생 6명과 컨소시엄 학생 28명은 6개 혼합 팀을 구성해 ‘생물·언어·문화 다양성 회복을 위한 글로벌 프로젝트’를 수행했다.)

Each team selected topics such as animal welfare and biodiversity conservation, preservation of indigenous languages, marine plastic and coral ecosystem restoration, and wildfire prevention and forest management. Students conducted preliminary online meetings, local interviews, and data research, proposing solutions leveraging AI technology and field survey results, culminating in final presentations. (각 팀은 동물복지와 생물다양성 보전, 원주민 언어 보존, 해양 플라스틱과 산호 생태계 복원, 산불 예방과 산림 관리 등을 주제로 선정했다. 학생들은 사전 온라인 회의와 현지 인터뷰, 자료 조사를 거쳐 AI 기술과 현장 조사 결과를 활용한 해결 방안을 제안하고 최종 발표를 진행했다.)

Professor Hwang Dong-wook of the Department of Media and Communication at Kwangwoon University, who oversaw the PBL instruction, said, "Students investigated social and environmental issues in Australia on-site and collaborated with UNSW students to propose solutions. It is meaningful that students from different linguistic and cultural backgrounds completed joint outcomes." (PBL 지도를 맡은 황동욱 광운대 미디어커뮤니케이션학부 교수는 “학생들이 호주의 사회·환경 문제를 현장에서 조사하고 UNSW 학생들과 협업해 해결 방안을 제시했다”며 “서로 다른 언어와 문화적 배경을 가진 학생들이 공동 결과물을 완성했다는 점에서 의미가 있다”고 말했다.)

Participating students conducted Korean language and culture education volunteer work for local elementary, middle, and high school students at Sydney Sae-soon Hangul School. They operated programs including traditional games, sports activities, hanbok (traditional Korean clothing) experiences, folk painting scratch art, making traditional Korean sweets (han-gwa), and craft programs. (참가 학생들은 시드니 새순한글학교에서 현지 초·중·고등학생을 대상으로 한국어·한국문화 교육 봉사를 진행했다. 전통 놀이와 체육활동, 한복 체험, 민화 스크래치 아트, 한과 만들기, 공예 프로그램 등을 운영했다.)

Local lectures and visits to institutions and companies were also conducted for career exploration. Participants attended lectures by a UNSW professor on Australian university admissions and career paths, as well as a lecture by the Sydney Korean Education Center on the Australian education system and culture. At KOTRA Sydney Trade Center, they explored the Australian economy and Korea-Australia business exchange status. (진로 탐색을 위한 현지 특강과 기관·기업 방문도 실시했다. 참가자들은 UNSW 교수의 호주 대학 입시·진로 특강과 시드니한국교육원의 호주 교육제도·문화 특강에 참여했다. KOTRA 시드니무역관에서는 호주 경제와 한·호주 비즈니스 교류 현황을 살펴봤다.)

Additionally, they visited Korean companies operating locally, such as Woori Bank, Hana Bank, and Hyundai Corporation's Sydney office, to receive explanations on overseas business operations and local work environments. At Bondi Beach, they carried out ESG social contribution programs, including environmental cleanup activities. (이와 함께 우리은행, 하나은행, 현대상사 시드니법인 등 현지 진출 한국 기업을 방문해 해외 사업 운영과 현지 업무 환경에 대한 설명을 들었다. 본다이비치 일대에서는 환경정화 활동 등 ESG 사회공헌 프로그램을 수행했다.)

Deputy Director Lee Dong-eun stated, "We structured the program so students could experience intercultural communication and on-site problem-solving through joint projects, educational volunteering, and company visits. We plan to continuously operate overseas field education based on collaboration with local universities, institutions, and companies." (이동은 부단장은 “공동 프로젝트와 교육 봉사, 기업 탐방을 통해 학생들이 문화 간 소통과 현장 문제 해결 과정을 경험하도록 프로그램을 구성했다”며 “현지 대학과 기관, 기업과의 협력을 바탕으로 해외 현장교육을 지속적으로 운영할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the HUSS Global Symbiosis Consortium includes Kwangwoon University, Kookmin University, Sun Moon University, Yeungnam University, and Honam University. Since 2024, the consortium has been running a convergence talent cultivation program funded by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea for three years, focusing on fostering sustainable resource responsiveness, sustainable industry understanding, and sustainable international society inclusivity. (한편 HUSS 글로벌공생컨소시엄에는 광운대·국민대·선문대·영남대·호남대가 참여하고 있다. 컨소시엄은 2024년부터 3년간 교육부와 한국연구재단의 지원을 받아 지속가능 자원 대응력, 지속가능 산업 이해력, 지속가능 국제사회 포용력을 갖춘 융합인재 양성 프로그램을 운영하고 있다.)

item.title: University of Seoul's Urban Elderly Health Exercise Research Institute Presents Practical Physical Activity Strategies for Low-Income Groups (서울시립대 도시노인건강운동연구소, 저소득층 위한 실용적 신체활동 전략 제시)
item.description:
The University of Seoul (President Won Yong-geol) Urban Elderly Health Exercise Research Institute (Director Professor Je Se-young) announced research findings that so-called "Weekend Warrior" exercise, where physical activity is concentrated on weekends, is associated with a lower likelihood of hypertension, and that this association is particularly pronounced in low-income groups. (서울시립대학교(총장 원용걸) 도시노인건강운동연구소(소장 제세영 교수)는 주말에 운동을 집중하는 이른바 ‘주말 운동(Weekend Warrior)'이 낮은 고혈압 유병 가능성과 관련이 있으며, 특히 저소득층에서 이러한 연관성이 더욱 뚜렷하게 나타났다는 연구 결과를 발표했다.)

The research team analyzed data from 28,039 adults who participated in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey from 2018 to 2023. They confirmed that individuals who concentrated their exercise on 1-2 days per week had a lower likelihood of hypertension compared to those who engaged in no physical activity, and this association was more significant in low-income groups. (연구팀은 2018년부터 2023년까지 국민건강영양조사에 참여한 성인 2만 8,039명을 분석한 결과, 신체활동이 전혀 없는 사람과 비교해 주 1~2일에 운동을 집중한 사람은 고혈압 유병 가능성이 낮았으며, 이러한 연관성은 저소득층에서 더욱 크게 나타났음을 확인했다.)

Professor Je Se-young, the lead researcher, explained, "Not everyone can exercise regularly on weekdays. For those who face barriers to exercise participation due to long working hours and economic constraints, concentrating exercise on weekends can be a practical alternative." (연구책임자인 제세영 교수는 "모든 사람이 평일에 규칙적으로 운동할 수 있는 것은 아니다.”라며 "긴 노동시간과 경제적 제약 등으로 운동 참여가 어려운 계층에게는 주말에 운동을 집중하는 방식도 현실적인 대안이 될 수 있다.”고 설명했다.)

This study supports the research direction of the Urban Elderly Health Exercise Research Institute, which aims to improve health equity among vulnerable urban elderly populations and develop feasible physical activity strategies. (이번 연구는 도시 취약계층 노인의 건강형평성 향상과 실천 가능한 신체활동 전략 개발을 목표로 하는 도시노인건강운동연구소의 연구 방향을 뒷받침하는 성과이다.)

Meanwhile, this research was conducted as part of the "Humanities and Social Sciences Research Institute Support Project" funded by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea. The findings were published online in Clinical Hypertension, the official international journal of the Korean Society of Hypertension. (한편, 이번 연구는 교육부와 한국연구재단이 지원하는 「인문사회연구소지원사업」의 일환으로 수행됐으며, 연구 결과는 대한고혈압학회 공식 국제학술지 Clinical Hypertension에 온라인 게재됐다.)

item.title: Eating Out Costs Are Rising…Now Instant Rice, Tuna Cans, and Curry Are Going Up Too (외식 물가도 비싸지는데…햇반·참치캔·카레도 오른다)
item.description:
Following the rise in eating-out costs, the prices of "home-cooking essentials" such as instant rice, tuna cans, and curry are also increasing, which is expected to further weigh on consumers' wallets. Major food companies are joining the price hike trend due to prolonged high exchange rates and high oil prices, which have driven up the cost of imported raw materials and packaging, as well as logistics expenses. (외식 물가에 이어 햇반·참치캔·카레 등 ‘집밥 필수품’의 가격도 오르면서 소비자가 체감하는 장바구니 부담이 한층 커질 전망이다. 주요 식품업계가 고환율 장기화와 고유가 여파로 수입 원재료와 포장재 가격이 오른 데다, 물류비 부담으로 가격 인상 행렬에 동참하면서다.)

On the 16th, CJ CheilJedang announced a price increase averaging 8% across 27 items in 8 product categories, including instant rice, dumplings, and grilled fish. Specifically, instant rice will rise by 12%, grilled fish by 8.4%, and dumplings by 4.6%. The new prices will take effect in large supermarkets from the 30th of this month and in convenience stores from August 1st. (씨제이(CJ)제일제당은 햇반·만두·생선구이 등 8개 제품군에서 27개 품목의 가격을 평균 8% 인상한다고 지난 16일 밝혔다. 구체적으로는 햇반 12%, 생선구이 8.4%, 만두 4.6% 등이다. 대형마트는 이달 30일부터, 편의점은 8월1일부터 인상 가격이 적용된다.)

A CJ CheilJedang official stated, "We have tried to absorb price increases as much as possible, but with the continued rise in the cost of key raw and subsidiary materials, the burden on costs has grown, leading us to adjust the prices of some products." Considering the burden on consumers, popular items among younger demographics such as instant rice cups, dessert products, refrigerated and frozen noodle products, and sauces were excluded from this price hike, according to the explanation. (씨제이제일제당 쪽은 “그동안 가격 인상 요인을 최대한 감내해왔으나, 주요 원·부재료비 상승이 지속되면서 원가 부담이 커져 일부 제품의 가격을 조정하게 됐다”고 했다. 소비자 부담을 고려해 젊은 층이 많이 찾는 햇반 컵반과 디저트 제품, 냉장·냉동면제품, 장류는 이번 인상에서 제외했다는 설명이다.)

Ottogi raised the factory prices of 29 items, including curry, glass noodles, ketchup, and pepper, starting on the 16th. Pepper products increased by an average of 17%, glass noodles by an average of 10%, and curry and ketchup by 6.1% each. This marks the first price adjustment in two years since August 2024. Sajo decided to raise the factory prices of key processed foods, such as tuna cans, starting next month and is currently negotiating with large supermarkets. Tuna can products will see a 10% increase, while canned seafood like mackerel and Pacific saury will rise by 20%. (오뚜기는 지난 16일부터 카레와 당면, 케첩, 후추 등 29개 품목 출고가를 인상했다. 후추류는 평균 17%, 당면류는 평균 10%, 카레류·케첩류는 각각 6.1%씩 인상했다. 2024년 8월 이후 2년 만의 가격 조정이다. 사조는 다음 달부터 참치캔 등 주요 가공식품의 출고가를 인상하기로 하고 대형마트와 협의 중이다. 참치캔 제품은 10%, 꽁치·고등어 등 수산 캔 제품은 20% 오른다.)

This wave of price increases is expected to further strain household food expenses. Earlier, the dining-out and franchise industry began raising prices from the start of the second quarter, focusing on mid-to-low-priced brands. The Born Korea, which operates brands like Yeokjeon Udon and Saemaeul Sikdang, raised the prices of certain menu items across 11 restaurant brands by an average of 11% starting last month. (이 같은 가격 인상 흐름에 따라 가계의 식비 부담은 더욱 가중될 것으로 보인다. 앞서 외식·프랜차이즈 업계는 중저가 브랜드를 중심으로 2분기 초부터 가격을 인상하기 시작했다. 역전우동·새마을식당 등을 운영하는 더본코리아는 지난달 9일부터 11개 외식 브랜드의 일부 메뉴 가격을 평균 11% 인상했다.)

Goobne Chicken reduced the pre-cooking weight of its boneless chicken thigh menu from 800g to 700g and raised the prices of some side dishes. Lotteria also increased the prices of 22 types of single burgers by an average of 2.9% starting last May, with price increases ranging from a minimum of 100 won to a maximum of 300 won per product. (굽네치킨은 닭다리살 순살 메뉴의 조리 전 중량을 800g에서 700g으로 줄인 데 이어, 일부 사이드 메뉴 가격을 올렸다. 롯데리아도 지난 5월부터 단품 버거류 22종의 가격을 평균 2.9% 인상하면서 제품별로 최소 100원에서 최대 300원까지 가격이 올랐다.)

Hyemi Seo, reporter ham@hani.co.kr (서혜미 기자 ham@hani.co.kr)

item.title: One in Four New Cars Is an Import: Tesla, BMW, Mercedes-Benz + BYD Form 'New Big Four' Structure (신차 4대 중 1대는 수입차…테슬라·BMW·벤츠 + BYD ‘신 4강 구도’)
item.description:
Sales of imported cars are rapidly increasing. In the first half of this year, total vehicle sales rose 2.5% year-on-year, while passenger car sales alone increased by 4.4%, but the growth rate for imported car sales surpassed 30%. Electric vehicles have shattered the stagnant imported car market at once. (수입차 판매가 빠르게 늘고 있다. 올해 상반기 자동차 판매는 전년 동기 대비 2.5%, 승용차 판매만 놓고 보면 4.4% 증가했는데, 수입차 판매 증가율은 30%가 넘는다. 전기차가 정체된 수입차 시장을 단박에 깨버렸다.)

According to data compiled by the Korea Automobile & Mobility Association (KAMA) and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy on the 17th, a total of 774,547 passenger cars were sold in the domestic market in the first half of this year. Of these, sales from 25 imported car brands, excluding the five domestic automakers, amounted to 183,896 units (23.7%). Data from the Korea Imported Automobile Association shows that the market share of imported cars (based on annual sales of passenger and commercial vehicles) first reached 1% in 2002 and surpassed the 10% threshold in 2012. Last year, it recorded 20.3%, entering the 20% range for the first time. <<> Based on data compiled by the Caizu Data Research Institute, sales of imported passenger cars in the first half of the year increased by 31.8% compared to the same period last year. The institute stated, "In the first half of this year, the proportion of imported cars in the new passenger car registration market is the highest for the first half of any year in the past five years. This contrasts with the 5.6% decline in domestic car sales during the same period." <<> Three out of ten newly sold imported cars (30.5%) were Teslas. Selling 56,139 units, Tesla ranked first in imported passenger car sales in the first half. Second was BMW with 39,150 units, and third was Mercedes-Benz with 29,776 units. The top three brands accounted for 68% of total imported car sales. Fourth place went to BYD, an emerging Chinese electric vehicle brand that sold 11,675 units. The Caizu Data Research Institute noted, "BYD overtaking Lexus (5th) and Volvo (6th) to enter fourth place in the imported car market clearly shows that the domestic market structure is changing." Seventh place was Audi, eighth was Toyota, ninth was Porsche, and tenth was Mini. <<> According to the Caizu Data Research Institute's tally, 45.5% (83,928 units) of imported passenger cars sold in the first half were electric vehicles. They sold nearly 10,000 more units than gasoline cars (74,731 units, 40.5%). The institute commented, "The imported car market, which had a high share of diesel vehicles until 2023, has been restructured around electric vehicles in just a few years." It analyzed, "The expansion of Tesla Model Y and Model 3's affordable models in Korea, along with BYD's entry with mid-to-low-priced electric vehicles, has lowered the barrier for imported electric vehicles. The same tax benefits and subsidies for electric vehicles applied equally to imports have also accelerated this trend." <<> Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr ( 17일 한국자동차모빌리티산업협회(KAMA), 산업통상부 자료를 종합하면, 올해 상반기 국내에서 팔린 승용차는 77만4547대다. 이 가운데 국내 5개 완성차업체를 제외한 25개 수입차 브랜드 판매량은 18만3896대(23.7%)였다. 한국수입자동차협회 자료를 보면, 수입차 점유율(승용차·상용차 연간 판매량 기준)은 2002년 처음으로 1%, 2012년에는 10% 벽을 넘었다. 지난해에는 20.3%를 기록하며 처음 20%대로 진입했다. )

item.title: Chey Tae-won: "If You Hold SK Hynix Stock Steadily, It Will Trend Upward" (최태원 “SK하닉 주식, 가만히 갖고 있으면 우상향”)
item.description:
Chey Tae-won, Chairman of the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry (and Chairman of SK Group), commented on the outlook for SK Hynix's stock price, stating, "Since memory (semiconductors) will continue to be needed, it will trend upward over time." (최태원 대한상공회의소 회장(SK그룹 회장)이 에스케이하이닉스의 주가 전망을 두고 “메모리(반도체)는 계속 필요하기 때문에 시간을 두면 우상향으로 간다”고 했다.)

In a discussion at the 'KCCI Jeju Forum' held at the Jeju Shilla Hotel in Seogwipo, Jeju Island, on the 17th, Chairman Chey said, "I don't even know what the stock price will be next month, but rather than buying and selling, sitting on it quietly is a good way to preserve wealth." Chairman Chey also serves as Chairman (non-registered executive) of SK Hynix. <<> He explained, "Artificial intelligence (AI) is still a 4-year-old child, but to become an adult, memory will inevitably be used," adding, "The demand for it will inevitably grow exponentially." Chey further noted, "The sudden 10-fold increase in stock prices (of semiconductor companies) is due to this phenomenon," and pointed out, "When the outlook improves, it goes up, and when things seem a bit off, it can plummet sharply. It rises too quickly, and it also takes time to adjust to reality." (최 회장은 17일 제주도 서귀포시 제주신라호텔에서 열린 ‘대한상의 제주포럼’ 대담에서 “다음달 주가가 어떻게 될지는 저도 모르지만, 샀다 팔았다 하지 말고 가만히 갖고 있는 게 재산 보전에 좋은 방법”이라며 이같이 말했다. 최 회장은 에스케이하이닉스의 회장(미등기 임원)도 맡고 있다.)

On this day, Chairman Chey proposed targeting niche markets as a strategy for South Korea's AI industry, circumventing the hegemonic competition between the US and China. He said, "It's hard for Korea to lower token costs, and it's also difficult to beat the US in quality," adding, "We need to lay down the infrastructure, build the applications we need on top of it, and create niche markets." Specifically, he advised, "Rather than just selling memory, we should create and sell computing capacity," and "In the future, the strategy should shift from exporting goods to exporting intelligence." (그는 “인공지능(AI)은 아직 4살짜리 어린아이지만 성인이 되려면 메모리가 쓰일 수밖에 없다”면서 “그 수요가 기하급수적으로 늘어날 수밖에 없다”고 설명했다. 그러면서 최 회장은 “(반도체 기업들의) 주가가 갑자기 10배씩 오른 것도 이런 현상 때문”이라며 “전망이 좋아지면 올라갔다가 조금 아닌 거 같으면 확 떨어지기도 한다. 너무 빨리 올라서 현실을 적응시킬 때도 있다”고 짚었다.)

Additionally, Chairman Chey pointed out, "Future education should not be rote learning but should focus on finding what is beneficial to human life," and "The era where talent is defined only by graduating from university is over." (이날 최 회장은 한국의 인공지능 산업 전략으로 미국과 중국의 패권 경쟁을 우회하는 틈새시장 공략을 제안했다. 그는 “한국은 토큰 코스트를 낮추기도 힘들고 퀄리티로 미국을 이기기도 어렵다”며 “우리는 인프라를 깔아서 그 위에 우리가 필요한 애플리케이션을 만들고 틈새시장을 만들어야 한다”고 했다. 구체적으로는 “메모리만 계속 팔 게 아니라 컴퓨팅 용량을 만들어서 팔아야 한다”며 “미래에는 상품이 아니라 지능을 수출하는 형태로 전략을 바꿔야 한다”고 조언했다.)

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr (또 최 회장은 “미래 교육은 주입식이 아니라 인간 생활에 도움이 되는 걸 찾아야 한다”면서 “대학을 나와야만 인재라는 시대는 끝났다”고 지적했다.)

item.title: Only 4.4% of Seoul Apartments Cost Over 3 Billion Won…Debate Over ‘Ultra-High-End Home’ Threshold Heats Up (30억원 이상 서울 아파트 4.4%뿐…‘초고가 주택’ 기준 놓고 갑론을박)
item.description:
Ahead of the government’s tax reform announcement later this month, attention is focused on the level of property tax hikes for single ultra-high-end homes. With apartments in Seoul valued at 3 billion won or more accounting for less than 5% of total transactions, experts are divided over where to set the ultra-high-end threshold. (이달 말 정부의 세제개편안 발표를 앞두고 초고가 1주택에 대한 보유세 강화 수준이 어느 정도에서 이뤄질지 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 서울 아파트 시가 기준으로 30억원 이상은 5%도 채 되지 않는 가운데, 전문가들 사이에서도 초고가 기준을 놓고 의견이 엇갈리고 있다.)

According to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport’s real transaction price system on the 17th, among 75,782 apartment transactions in Seoul over the past year—from the second half of last year (July to December) to the first half of this year (January to June)—3,340 units, or 4.4% of the total, were priced at 3 billion won or more. Of these high-value transactions, 82.0% (2,736 units) took place in the three Gangnam districts (Gangnam, Seocho, and Songpa), while Yongsan (265 units) and Yeongdeungpo (118 units) also recorded over 100 transactions. Transactions over 3 billion won were also reported in Yangcheon, Seongdong, Gwangjin, Jongno, Gangdong, Dongjak, Mapo, and Jung-gu. <<> Narrowing the range to apartments valued at 4 billion won or more, the share fell to 1.5% (1,120 units), and for those at 5 billion won or more, it was 0.7% (552 units). Among transactions over 5 billion won, 90% (496 units) were concentrated in the three Gangnam districts. <<> Within the industry, the prevailing view is that the “ultra-high-end” threshold for homes will likely be set between 3 billion and 5 billion won in market value. On the 14th, President Lee Jae-myung, during a Cabinet meeting, solicited viewer opinions via YouTube live stream comments about the ultra-high-end home standard. When Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom noted, “Many people answered 2 billion won,” President Lee expressed a negative stance, saying, “If we do that, I think we’ll be in big trouble.” After the most common response suggested 3 billion won as the threshold for ultra-high-end homes, President Lee remarked, “Isn’t that too harsh? A market price of 3 billion won would only be about 100 to 200 million won in official assessed value, wouldn’t it?” <<> Experts are also split on where to set the ultra-high-end threshold. Lee Gwang-soo, representative of the YouTube channel ‘Gwangsu’s Bokdeokbang,’ who participated as a panelist at the ‘Real Estate Tax Public Opinion Forum’ hosted by the Ministry of Economy and Finance on the 16th, proposed a threshold of 4 billion won. He stated, “Changing the law (to lower the tax burden) for 30,000 people who own homes worth 4 billion won or more is impossible. I believe no politician in the future will give up the corrective role of taxes for just 30,000 people,” adding, “It’s about the sustainability of the tax system.” Professor Shim Chung-jin of Konkuk University (Business Administration) argued for increasing the tax burden on homes worth 5 billion won by reducing the comprehensive real estate tax deduction rate. He suggested, “Applying a 69% market price-to-official-value ratio to a 5 billion won home results in an official price of about 3.5 billion won. For homes above this value, it’s necessary to deduct the application rate by 10 percentage points when applying the comprehensive real estate tax.” <<> Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr ( 17일 국토교통부 실거래가 공개시스템을 보면, 지난해 하반기(7~12월)부터 올 상반기(1~6월)까지 1년간 서울 아파트 거래 7만5782건 중 시가 30억원 이상은 3340건으로 전체에서 4.4%의 비중을 차지했다. 30억원 이상 거래 중 82.0%(2736건)는 강남·서초·송파 등 강남 3구에서 이뤄졌고, 용산(265건)과 영등포(118건)도 100건 이상이었다. 양천·성동·광진·종로·강동·동작·마포·중구에서도 30억원 이상 거래가 있었다. )

item.title: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix stocks plunge up to 50% in a month… Retail investors turn back to US markets (‘삼전·닉스 주식들’ 한달 새 최대 -50%…개미는 다시 미장 찾아)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which had been driving the domestic stock market rally, saw their stock prices halve over the past month. The KOSPI, which had broken through the 9,000-point mark for the first time in history, has since plummeted sharply, falling below 7,000 points, swinging between hot and cold extremes. (국내 주식시장 활황을 이끌던 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 주가가 한달 새 반토막으로 줄었다. 그동안 코스피는 사상 첫 9천선을 돌파했다가, 가파르게 고꾸라져 7천선이 무너지는 등 냉온탕을 오갔다.)

According to data from the Korea Exchange for the past month (June 16 to July 16), the decline from the peak (June 19) to the trough (July 14) of Samsung Electronics, the largest stock by market capitalization on the KOSPI, was -34.0%, while the decline from the peak (June 25) to the trough (July 14) of SK Hynix, the second-largest, reached -43.8%. The KOSPI, which started at 4,000 points early this year, surpassed 5,000 in late January, 6,000 in late February, 7,000 in early May, 8,000 in late May, and crossed 9,000 on the 18th of last month. Since then, the major semiconductor stocks that led the KOSPI rally each hit record highs before crashing over the past month. (17일 한국거래소의 지난 한달(6월16일∼7월16일) 자료를 보면, 유가증권시장 시가총액 1위인 삼성전자 주가의 최고점(6월19일) 기준 최저점(7월14일) 하락률은 -34.0%, 시가총액 2위인 에스케이하이닉스의 주가 최고점(6월25일) 대비 최저점(7월14일) 하락률은 -43.8%에 달했다. 올해 초 4천선에서 출발한 코스피가 1월 말 5천선, 2월 말 6천선, 5월 초 7천선, 5월 말 8천선을 넘어 지난달 18일 9천선을 넘어선 이후 코스피 상승장을 이끌던 반도체 대형주가 각각 최고치를 기록했다가 한달 새 폭락한 것이다.)

Stocks related to these two companies, which had benefited from their price movements, also saw their values halve across the board. SK Square, which is the largest shareholder of SK Hynix, ranked third by market capitalization on the KOSPI, and once surpassed 2 million won per share, saw its decline from the peak (June 23) to the trough (July 14) over the past month reach -50.4%. The group's holding company, SK, recorded -38.5%. Samsung Electro-Mechanics, a parts supplier that had experienced rapid growth benefiting from the AI-driven semiconductor boom alongside Samsung Electronics, also saw its decline from the peak (June 19) to the trough (July 14) hit -51.9%. Samsung Life Insurance and Samsung C&T, which had drawn attention as Samsung Electronics affiliates, posted declines of -41.7% and -40.7%, respectively. (이들 두 종목의 주가에 연동돼 수혜를 받던 관련주도 일제히 반토막이 났다. 에스케이하이닉스의 최대주주로 유가증권시장 시가총액 3위에 올랐을 뿐만 아니라 한때 1주당 200만원을 돌파했던 에스케이(SK)스퀘어의 한달 새 주가 최고점(6월23일) 기준 최저점(7월14일) 하락률은 -50.4%였다. 그룹 지주사인 에스케이(SK)는 -38.5%였다. 삼성전자와 함께 인공지능(AI)발 반도체 초호황의 수혜를 입으며 급격한 성장을 이루고 있는 부품 업체 삼성전기의 주가 최고점(6월19일) 대비 최저점(7월14일) 하락률도 -51.9%에 달했다. 삼성전자 관계사로 주목받았던 삼성생명과 삼성물산도 각각 하락률이 -41.7%, -40.7%였다.)

The decline from the KOSPI's peak (June 19) to its trough (July 14) was -31.3%. Over the same period (local time), according to MarketWatch data, the Nasdaq Composite Index, composed of leading US tech stocks, saw a decline of about -6.6% from its peak (June 16) to its trough (June 26), and the recent index has not fallen below that trough. The S&P 500 index, centered on large-cap stocks, actually rose, with the increase from its trough (June 26) to its peak (July 15) reaching 3.9%. (코스피의 최고점(6월19일) 기준 최저점(7월14일) 하락률은 -31.3%였다. 같은 기간(현지시각 기준) 마켓워치 자료를 보면, 미국 대표 기술주로 구성된 나스닥 종합지수의 최고점(6월16일) 대비 최저점(6월26일) 하락률은 -6.6% 정도였고, 최근의 지수는 최저점 밑으로 떨어지지 않았다. 대형주 중심의 스탠다드앤드푸어스(S&P)500 지수는 오히려 상승했기 때문에 최저점(6월26일) 대비 최고점(7월15일) 상승률은 3.9%였다.)

As the KOSPI's returns deteriorated sharply, the "Seohak ants" (South Korean retail investors investing in US stocks), who had been gradually returning to the domestic market amid its rally, are now turning back to the US stock market. According to data from the Korea Securities Depository, net purchases of US stocks amounted to $1.79509 billion (approximately 2.6594 trillion won) from June through the day before. In April to May, sell orders exceeded buys, resulting in net sales of $1.4087 billion (approximately 2.087 trillion won). This indicates that the Seohak ants who had shifted to the domestic market have now largely exited back to the US. (유독 코스피의 수익률이 급격히 악화되자 그간 국내 증시 활황으로 하나둘씩 복귀하던 ‘서학개미’들도 미국 증시로 발길을 돌리고 있다. 한국예탁결제원 자료를 보면, 지난 6월부터 전날까지 미국주식 순매수 금액은 17억9509만달러(약 2조6594억원)에 달했다. 지난 4∼5월은 매도금액이 더 많아서 순매도 금액이 14억870만달러(약 2조870억원)였다. 국장으로 유턴했던 서학개미가 고스란히 미국으로 빠져나간 셈이다.)

item.title: Google Stumbles on Coding Performance—'Gemini 3.5 Pro' Launch Delayed Again (코딩 성능에 발목 잡힌 구글…‘제미나이 3.5 프로’ 출시 또 연기)
item.description:
Reports indicate that the launch of Google's next-generation flagship AI model, 'Gemini 3.5 Pro,' has been delayed by several months from its original schedule due to performance issues. Google, which had regained its AI competitiveness last year with the image generation model 'Nano Banana,' is now facing growing concerns that it may once again cede the lead to OpenAI and Anthropic. (구글의 차세대 플래그십 인공지능(AI) 모델 ‘제미나이 3.5 프로’의 출시가 성능 문제로 당초 계획보다 수개월 늦어지고 있다는 보도가 나왔다. 지난해 이미지 생성 모델 ‘나노 바나나’로 인공지능 경쟁력을 회복한 것으로 평가받았던 구글은 또 다시 오픈에이아이(AI)와 앤트로픽에 주도권을 내줄 수 있다는 위기감이 커지고 있다.)

Bloomberg reported on the 17th (local time), citing multiple current and former Google employees, that the repeated delays in the launch of Gemini 3.5 Pro are causing increasing frustration among engineers, researchers, and managers. ( 블룸버그통신은 17일(현지시각) 복수의 구글 전·현직 직원을 인용해 제미나이 3.5 프로 출시가 잇달아 연기되면서 엔지니어와 연구원, 관리자들의 좌절감이 커지고 있다고 전했다.)

Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai announced at the annual developer conference in May that Gemini 3.5 Pro would be released in June. However, the timeline has been continuously pushed back due to performance improvements and testing, and as of mid-July, a specific release date has yet to be confirmed. ( 순다르 피차이 알파벳 최고경영자(CEO)는 지난 5월 연례 개발자 행사에서 제미나이 3.5 프로를 6월 중 출시하겠다고 밝혔지만, 이후 성능 개선과 테스트를 이유로 일정이 계속 미뤄지면서 7월 중순이 된 현재까지도 구체적인 출시 시점을 확정하지 못하고 있다.)

The primary cause is reported to be performance issues. Google updated Gemini's training data late last month to boost coding performance, but the results fell short of internal expectations. Following this news, Alphabet's stock closed at $354.46, down 4.4% from the previous trading day. ( 가장 큰 원인은 성능 문제인 것으로 전해졌다. 구글은 지난달 말 코딩 성능을 끌어올리기 위해 제미나이의 학습용 데이터를 업데이트했지만, 개선 결과가 내부 기대치에 미치지 못했다는 것이다. 이 소식이 알려진 뒤 알파벳 주가는 전 거래일보다 4.4% 하락한 354.46달러에 거래를 마쳤다.)

Sources pointed not only to technical limitations but also to the massive organization and complex decision-making system as major factors in the launch delay. According to Bloomberg, key executives, including co-founder Sergey Brin, urged faster development and release of new models to secure leadership in the AI coding market. However, organizations such as Google Cloud, Google DeepMind, and the Android OS team are each independently developing AI coding tools, and entangled interests among these groups are preventing synergy. A former Google employee described efforts to align leadership across all departments as "as difficult as boiling the ocean." ( 소식통들은 기술적 한계뿐 아니라 거대한 조직과 복잡한 의사결정 체계도 출시 지연의 주요 원인으로 꼽았다. 블룸버그에 따르면 세르게이 브린 공동창업자 등 핵심 경영진은 인공지능 코딩 시장 주도권 확보를 위해 신규 모델 개발과 출시 속도를 높여야 한다고 주문했지만, 구글 클라우드·구글 딥마인드·안드로이드 운영체제(OS) 조직 등이 각각 독자적으로 인공지능 코딩 도구를 개발하는 등 조직 간 이해관계가 얽히면서 시너지를 내지 못하고 있다는 것이다. 한 전직 구글 직원은 모든 부서의 리더십을 한 방향으로 움직이게 하려는 시도는 “바닷물을 끓이려는 것처럼 어렵다”고 말했다.)

Additionally, some engineers' firm stance that 'important code must be written by humans' has been cited as another obstacle to rapid model development. ( 아울러 일부 엔지니어들이 ‘중요한 코드는 사람이 직접 작성해야 한다’는 완강한 입장을 고수한 것도 신속한 모델 개발의 걸림돌로 작용했다는 분석이다. )

In response to the reports, Google stated, "We are working to quickly launch various AI models while maintaining cost efficiency. We are currently testing Gemini 3.5 Pro and an improved Flash model, while also discussing model validation and the AI safety framework with the U.S. government." ( 구글은 해당 보도에 대해 “우리는 비용 효율성을 유지하면서 다양한 인공지능 모델을 신속하게 출시하기 위해 노력하고 있다”며 “현재 제미나이 3.5 프로와 성능이 향상된 플래시(Flash) 모델 등을 테스트하는 한편, 모델 검증과 인공지능 안전 프레임워크에 대해 미 정부와 논의하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Seon Dam sun@hani.co.kr ( 선담은 기자 sun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Samsung and SK Hynix Leverage: 'Cash Deposit of 30 Million Won + Trades of 20 Shares or More' – Will Investment Plunge? (삼전·닉스 레버리지 ‘현금예탁 3천만원+20주 이상 거래’…투자 급감할까)
item.description:
Sixteen single-stock leverage products (including two inverse products) for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have absorbed approximately 7 trillion won in funds over the past month. Attention is now focused on how investors will respond following the financial authorities' announcement on the 16th of measures to raise barriers to entry into single-stock leverage investments. (삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 16종(인버스 2종 포함)이 최근 한 달간 약 7조원의 자금을 빨아들인 것으로 나타났다. 16일 금융당국이 내놓은 단일종목 레버리지 진입 문턱 강화 대책에 따라 이제 투자자들이 어떤 선택 행동에 나설지 촉각이 쏠린다.)

According to the Korea Exchange and ETF Check Terminal on the 17th, from the 16th of last month to the 15th of this month, net purchases by individual investors across a total of 14 single-stock leverage products for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix amounted to 5.85 trillion won (4.2386 trillion won for seven SK Hynix single-stock leverage products and 1.6119 trillion won for seven Samsung Electronics leverage products). Including two inverse products for these two stocks, a total of 7.3364 trillion won in funds flowed into all 16 products. Despite significant declines in the prices of the underlying stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, money continued to pour into single-stock leverage products that track returns at double the rate. ( 17일 한국거래소와 ETF 체크단말기에 따르면 지난달 16일부터 지난 15일까지 삼성전자·하이닉스 두 단일종목 레버리지 총 14종에서 개인 투자자 순매수액은 5조8500억원(SK하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 7종 4조2386억원, 삼성전자 레버리지 7종 1조6119억원)에 달했다. 두 중목의 인버스 상품 2종까지 합치면 총 16종에 총 7조3364억원의 자금이 순유입됐다. 본주인 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 주가가 큰 폭 하락하는데도 수익률을 2배로 추종하는 단일종목 레버리지에는 오히려 계속 돈이 몰려든 것이다. )

During the period from June 16 to July 16, the stock price of SK Hynix fell by 19.49%, and Samsung Electronics by 24.33%. Consequently, the 'KODEX SK Hynix Single-Stock Leverage' and 'KODEX Samsung Electronics Single-Stock Leverage,' which saw the largest net fund inflows during this period, also dropped by 45.60% and 48.44%, respectively. The majority of funds flowing into single-stock leverage products came from individual investors, likely representing so-called 'cost averaging' funds aimed at betting on a price rebound. <<> Amid this, on the 16th, the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Financial Services Commission announced supplementary measures to significantly raise entry barriers for trading single-stock leverage products, including those for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, with a basic deposit of '30 million won in cash' and a basic trading unit of 20 shares, aiming to reduce and mitigate volatility in the domestic stock market. Market participants are keenly watching how demand will shift for the two single-stock leverage products (14 leverage products plus 2 inverse products) and how much this will reduce overall volatility in the KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets, which have been fluctuating around the underlying stock prices of these two issues. Based on a background briefing (questions and answers) on the 16th by Byun Jae-ho, Director of the Capital Markets Bureau at the Financial Services Commission, this analysis forecasts the impact of these supplementary measures on the market. However, noting the implementation dates for these revised investment requirements: the increase in the basic deposit from the existing 10 million won to 30 million won is set for around August 5th, the full exclusion of substitute securities (market value of held stocks, bonds, deposits) and recognition of only cash as the basic deposit is set for around August 19th, and the change in trading unit size is scheduled for November, considering system development times by securities firms. <<> -How much do you expect the demand for investing in these two single-stock leverage products to change due to these supplementary measures? <<> "We have estimated the effect in terms of how much investment demand might be impacted by the 30 million won cash requirement. It largely depends on investors' cash availability and how market conditions change, and significant volatility cannot be curbed solely by adjusting deposit requirements. However, based on internal estimates by financial authorities, we believe the total market capitalization of the 16 single-stock leverage products (currently about 12 trillion won) could shrink to less than one-third. While there is uncertainty, it is projected to be around 4 to 5 trillion won. When these two single-stock products were first listed (on May 27), securities firms expected a market cap of 4.4 trillion won. The decision to set the basic deposit at '30 million won in cash only' was based on the need to bring it back to that level. (Currently, among investors in single-stock leverage, it is estimated that only about 10% have the strengthened basic deposit requirement of 30 million won or more.) <<> In particular, the '30 million won cash deposit' applies not only to new investors but also to existing investors when making additional purchases. That is, if someone currently investing 30 million won in Samsung Electronics leverage wants to add another 10 million won, they would need to newly prepare and deposit another 30 million won in cash and then invest 10 million won from that amount. <<> Moreover, compared to the increase in the deposit amount, investors will likely feel the cash-only requirement as a greater constraint (currently, if investors held substitute securities such as stocks, bonds, or deposits, 70% of their market value was recognized as deposit, but from August 19, this will be fully abolished and only cash will be accepted). The 30 million won amount is not the only important factor; the cash-only approach is expected to significantly contribute to easing demand." <<> -Raising the trading unit to 20 shares could potentially increase the investment amount per person (Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix single-stock leverage products are issued and traded at prices similar to typical leverage products, around 10,000 to 20,000 won, making it possible to invest in single shares at much lower prices than the underlying stocks, which are tracked at double leverage). <<> "There was discussion on whether to set the trading unit at a few shares, 10 shares, or 20 shares. However, wouldn't an investor, lacking certainty, typically only buy half of the unit? If decisions must be made in increments of 20 shares, investors would deliberate more and trade volumes could decrease. The larger investment amount has the effect of encouraging more cautious decision-making." <<> -There have been calls among market participants to delist these two single-stock leverage products. <<> "Conditions for delisting include the market capitalization shrinking too much, the disappearance of liquidity providers (brokerage firms), the correlation coefficient (between the underlying stock price and the leverage product's net asset value) being problematic, or the product failing to perform its function and not being managed properly. However, currently, single-stock leverage products are showing signs of overheating in the market to the point of excessive demand. While these delisting conditions do not apply, we understand the calls for delisting as a stance that strong measures are needed." <<> -Some suggest that lowering the leverage multiple for Samsung and Hynix tracking from 2x to around 1.5x could reduce investment demand. <<> "Regarding the leverage ratio adjustment, logically, setting it at 1.5x would contradict the purpose of introducing a leverage product, and it raises questions about what effect it would have. There is also the issue of creating a differential between domestic and foreign markets (where 2x is common in places like Hong Kong). Moreover, lowering it from 2x to 1.5x would require a 'beneficiary meeting,' which is more difficult to convene and pass than a shareholders' meeting." <<> Senior Reporter Cho Gyewan kyewan@hani.co.kr ( 지난 6월16일∼7월16일 기간에 SK하이닉스 주가는 19.49%, 삼성전자는 24.33% 각각 떨어졌다. 이에 따라, 이 기간에 자금 순유입 규모가 가장 컸던 ‘KODEX SK하이닉스단일종목레버리지’와 ‘KODEX 삼성전자단일종목레버리지’도 각각 45.60%, 48.44% 하락했다. 단일종목 레버리지로 흘러들어 간 자금 대다수는 개인투자자로, 주가 반등을 기대하는 이른바 ‘물타기’ 자금으로 추정된다. )

item.title: Ha Jung-woo: "AI-driven job loss is inevitable... Surplus tax revenue should be invested in youth and regions" (하정우 “AI발 고용 감소는 필연적…청년·지방에 초과 세수 투자해야”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, former Presidential Secretary for AI Future Strategy, argued that surplus tax revenue from the AI industry should be invested in the growth of youth and regions. (하정우 전 청와대 인공지능(AI) 미래기획수석이 인공지능 산업의 초과 세수를 청년과 지방 성장에 투자해야 한다고 주장했다.)

In a lecture at the 'Korea Economic Association Jeju Summer Forum' held in Seogwipo, Jeju on the 18th, former Secretary Ha stated, "As artificial intelligence boosts corporate productivity, a reduction in employment is inevitable. Growth without jobs and K-shaped polarization could occur." He added, "Surplus tax revenue should not only be used for future industries but also invested in the growth of the younger generation and regional development. We must utilize financial resources in areas where regions can leap forward through AI transformation (AX)." (하 전 수석은 18일 제주 서귀포에서 열린 ‘한국경제인협회 제주하계포럼’ 강연에서 “인공지능으로 기업 생산성이 높아지면 고용이 줄어드는 것은 필연적이다. 고용 없는 성장과 케이(K)자형 양극화가 일어날 수 있다”며 “초과 세수를 미래 먹거리에도 써야 하지만 청년 세대 성장과 지방 성장에도 투자해야 한다. 지방이 인공지능 전환(AX)를 통해 도약할 수 있는 분야에도 재원을 활용해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Former Secretary Ha expressed concern that social problems could arise if the fruits of AI industry growth, such as the semiconductor 'supercycle,' are concentrated among a few. He said, "If the fruits of growth are concentrated among a few, social problems will occur and it won't be sustainable. The nation and corporations must take care of it together." (하 전 수석은 반도체 ‘슈퍼사이클’ 등 인공지능 산업 성장의 과실이 소수에 집중되면 사회문제가 발생할 수 있다고 우려했다. 그는 “성장의 과실이 소수에 집중되면 사회문제가 발생하고, 지속 가능하지도 않다”며 “국가와 기업이 함께 챙겨야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Former Secretary Ha emphasized, "Becoming an exporter of intelligence is the direction our country should take," noting, "Global big tech companies are building data centers to secure intelligence factories." He further explained, "A token is the most basic unit for AI to understand the world and produce results, a piece of intelligence. An AI factory is a factory that produces 'intelligence'." He added, "If this intelligence is mounted on robots, we can become an 'intelligence exporter'." (하 전 수석은 “지능 수출국이 되는 것이 우리나라가 앞으로 나가야 할 방향”이라며 “전 세계 빅테크들이 지능 공장을 확보하기 위해 데이터센터를 짓고 있다”고 강조했다. 이어 ”토큰은 AI가 세상을 이해하고 결과를 만들어내는 가장 기본 단위이자 지능의 조각”이라며 “인공지능 팩토리는 만드는 물건이 ‘지능'인 공장”이라고 설명했다. 그러면서 “이 지능이 로봇에 탑재되면 우리는 ‘지능 수출국'이 될 수 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Referencing OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's remark, 'Singularity is Memory,' former Secretary Ha stressed, "The singularity was defined as the moment AI surpasses humans, and memory is that important. South Korea, with its world-class memory technology, is competitive." (하 전 수석은 오픈에이아이(Open AI) 최고경영자 샘 올트먼의 ‘특이점은 메모리(Singularity is Memory)’라는 발언을 언급하며 “특이점은 인공지능이 인간을 뛰어넘는 순간이라고 정의했는데 그만큼 메모리가 중요하며 세계 최고 수준의 메모리가 있는 우리나라는 경쟁력이 있다”고 강조했다.)

Regarding the strategic assetization of AI, he stated, "In the future, powerful AI will become a target of export controls," and explained, "A country must have more than one excellent AI to respond to strategic asset export controls. The government and industry must respond together." (그는 인공지능의 전략 자산화에 대해 “앞으로 강력한 인공지능은 수출 통제 대상이 될 것”이라며 “국가에 한 개 이상의 뛰어난 인공지능을 가지고 있어야 전략자산 수출 통제에 대응할 수 있다. 정부와 산업계가 함께 대응해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Chae Yoon-tae chai@hani.co.kr (채윤태 기자 chai@hani.co.kr)
